compliance.heading: Compliant by design
paragraphs: Every decision maps to the clause it rests on, the evidence it used and the person who made it. Your auditors, your regulator and your customers can request the full audit trail at the click of a button.
True Aim sits alongside the systems you already run. Your data stays yours, and so do your rules, limits and thresholds.
